reason: The sole cited evidence (E1) mentions preparing a FeCoNiCrMo0.2 + WC + CeO2 coating on 316L, but provides no data on CeO2 size, dispersion quality, grain refinement mechanism, or tribocorrosion performance relative to an HEA-only baseline. The key premises about optimal particle size, concentration, pinning mechanism, and marine performance are unsupported by the cited passage.
premises: Nano-CeO2 particles can be well-dispersed in a laser-clad HEA matrix at ~5 wt% and ~20 nm size
Nano-CeO2 acts as a grain-boundary pinning center, refining microstructure
Grain refinement and dislocation pinning by CeO2 increase hardness and reduce crack propagation
These microstructural changes enhance wear and corrosion resistance in marine environments
